text: Honestly this is a waste of time. My manager blamed me in front of everyone today for something I didn't even do, and I'm so mad I can't think straight.
I don't really feel anything lately. Work, home, it's all the same grey. I just go through the motions.

So okay, this week started with the car not starting, then my sister called about the thing with our dad's birthday plans, and I still haven't answered my landlord, and I keep meaning to go to the gym but then it's late and I'm on my phone again and I don't even know why I'm telling you all this.
I've tried breathing exercises before and they don't work for me. I don't see how talking to an app is going to change anything.
I have a presentation tomorrow morning and my chest is tight. I keep running through everything that could go wrong.
I snapped at my kid over something tiny this morning and I feel like a terrible parent.
My best friend moved to another country last month and the weekends feel really empty now.
Can you teach me something quick to calm down when I get overwhelmed at work?
I don't know. Things are just off.
